en-US.author: Astral Software Inc.
en-US.description: An extremely fast Python type checker and language server, written in Rust.
en-US.name: ty
en-US.releaseNotes:
Bug fixes
- Fix a panic when checking protocols involving runtime type aliases (#29840)
- Preserve Pydantic field metadata in quoted annotations (#29851)
- Resolve class-local names in generic type aliases (#29915)

LSP server
- Keep argument name hints display-only before later positional arguments or *args (#29801)
- Keep argument name hints display-only when they would insert duplicate or invalid keywords (#29806)
- Show field docstrings on hover for constructor keyword arguments (#29907)

CLI
- Give NO_COLOR precedence over FORCE_COLOR and CLICOLOR_FORCE in diagnostics (#29898)
- Honor color overrides in progress bars (#29891)
- Respect FORCE_COLOR in ty check even when output is piped (#29830)

Diagnostic improvements
- Avoid false redundant-cast diagnostics when casting the result of a generic call (#29835)

Core type checking
- Infer type arguments for union parameters using constraints from the whole call (#29236)
- Infer type arguments from generic TypedDict values passed to functions (#29903)
- Sync vendored typeshed stubs (#29869). Typeshed diff

Performance
- Avoid constraint solving when checking overlap between type variables in invariant positions (#29878)
- Cache subscript method resolution (#29824)
- Cache substitutions for generic type aliases (#29861)
- Defer member lookup when checking overrides (#29866)
- Find existing imports without scanning nested scopes (#29882)
- Reuse class metadata during member lookup (#29864)
- Reuse constructor bindings and defer looking up enclosing type variables (#29897)
- Reuse generic argument contexts across calls (#29877)
- Reuse inferred annotations when checking function returns (#29879)
- Reuse inherited override checks across subclasses (#29867)
- Reuse parameter unions when filtering overloads (#29823)
- Short-circuit equivalence checks against Never (#29862)
- Skip generic call inference when only a concrete receiver's Self needs binding (#29747)
- Skip unrelated statement calls when checking a single condition (#29826)
- Stop scanning package initializers once a legacy namespace declaration is found (#29885)

Memory usage improvements
- Prevent exponential memory growth when narrowing unions of intersections by equality (#29904)
